name: X/Twitter 搜索
description: 在 X (x.com) 搜索关键词，返回前10条推文（作者+文本+图片URL+时间）。需要登录 X 账号。

body.name: waitForURL
body.note: 等待搜索结果页导航完成

body.name: js

args.expression: (async()=>{await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2000));const loginWall=document.querySelector('[data-testid="login"]')||document.querySelector('[data-testid="sheetDialog"]')||document.querySelector('div[role="dialog"] input[name="text"]');if(loginWall){return {ok:false,reason:'login_required',detail:'X requires login to search. Please log in manually and re-run.'};}const captcha=document.querySelector('iframe[src*="captcha"],iframe[src*="recaptcha"],iframe[src*="arkose"]');if(captcha){return {ok:false,reason:'captcha',detail:'CAPTCHA detected. Manual intervention required.'};}const verify=document.querySelector('[data-testid="verification"]')||document.querySelector('div[class*="replace"][class*="bottom"]');if(verify){return {ok:false,reason:'verification',detail:'X is requesting phone/email verification.'};}return {ok:true};})()

body.name: js
body.note: 滚动触发虚拟列表懒加载

args.expression: (async()=>{const arts=document.querySelectorAll('article[data-testid="tweet"]');const tweets=[];const seen=new Set();for(const a of arts){if(tweets.length>=10)break;const u=a.querySelector('[data-testid="User-Name"]');const t=a.querySelector('[data-testid="tweetText"]');const tm=a.querySelector('time');const user=(u?.innerText||'').split('\n')[0].trim();const text=(t?.innerText||'').trim();const time=tm?.getAttribute('datetime')||'';const photos=a.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="tweetPhoto"]');const imgs=[];photos.forEach(p=>{p.querySelectorAll('img').forEach(img=>{const s=img.src||'';if(s.includes('pbs.twimg.com'))imgs.push(s);});});const key=user+text.slice(0,50);if(text.length>10&&!seen.has(key)){seen.add(key);tweets.push({user,text:text.slice(0,500),time,imgs:imgs.slice(0,4)});}}return {count:tweets.length,tweets};})()

outputs.name: tweets
outputs.description: 推文列表，每项含user、text、time、imgs（图片URL列表，需登录才能查看）
